  if Locale.Lookup(city:GetName()) == "Gwangju" then c = city end
end

c:GetBuildings():SetPillaged(b, true)
print("OK|pillaged|Gwangju|BUILDING_MONUMENT")
operations.readback_lua:

  if Locale.Lookup(city:GetName()) == "Gwangju" then c = city end
end

if c ~= nil and c:GetBuildings():IsPillaged(b) then
  print("OK|repair_city|Gwangju|BUILDING_MONUMENT|pillaged")

operations.lua:
local c = nil
for _, city in Players[0]:GetCities():Members() do
  if Locale.Lookup(city:GetName()) == "Jeonju" then c = city end
end
if c == nil then print("ERR|Jeonju missing") return end
local info = GameInfo.Buildings["BUILDING_GRANARY"]
local cb = c:GetBuildings()
if not cb:HasBuilding(info.Index) then print("ERR|Jeonju has no granary to remove") return end
if cb.RemoveBuilding == nil then
  print("ERR|CityBuildings:RemoveBuilding is not available in GameCore") return
end
cb:RemoveBuilding(info.Index)
print("OK|removed|Jeonju|BUILDING_GRANARY")
operations.readback_lua:
local minimum_surplus = 1
local c = nil
for _, city in Players[0]:GetCities():Members() do
  if Locale.Lookup(city:GetName()) == "Jeonju" then c = city end
end
if c == nil then print("ERR|Jeonju missing") return end
local info = GameInfo.Buildings["BUILDING_GRANARY"]
local gain = info.Housing or 0
local surplus = c:GetGrowth():GetHousing() - c:GetPopulation()
local granary = c:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(info.Index)
if not granary and surplus < minimum_surplus and surplus + gain >= minimum_surplus then
  print("OK|housing_city|Jeonju|surplus " .. surplus .. "|granary_housing " .. gain)
else
  print("ERR|Jeonju surplus " .. surplus .. " granary_housing " .. gain
        .. " has_granary " .. tostring(granary))
end

if p == nil then print("ERR|(67,22) missing") return end

print("OK|mine|67,22")
operations.readback_lua:
local p = Map.GetPlot(67, 22)
local imp = p ~= nil and p:GetImprovementType() or -1
local info = imp >= 0 and GameInfo.Improvements[imp] or nil
if info ~= nil and info.ImprovementType == "IMPROVEMENT_MINE"
    and not p:IsImprovementPillaged() and p:GetOwner() == 0 then
  print("OK|replacement_site|67,22|IMPROVEMENT_MINE|intact")
else
  print("ERR|(67,22) holds no intact owned mine")
end
